import re
def classify_retry(chunk, tries=4):
    items = "\n".join(f"{i}: {c}" for i,(_,c) in enumerate(chunk))
    prompt = ("Label each Portuguese e-commerce review comment with one letter:\n"
              "d=delivery complaint (late, not received, damaged in transit)\n"
              "p=product complaint (quality, defect, broke, not as described)\n"
              "s=seller complaint (wrong/missing item, refund, communication, cancellation)\n"
              "g=positive/satisfied with no real complaint\n"
              "o=other/vague/price or shipping cost complaint\n"
              "Answer exactly one line per item in the form 'index: letter'. No other text.\n\n" + items)
    best = {}
    for _ in range(tries):
        out = llm_query(prompt)
        found = re.findall(r'(\d+)\s*:\s*([dpsgo])', out)
        d = {int(a):b for a,b in found if int(a) < len(chunk)}
        if len(d) > len(best): best = d
        if len(best) == len(chunk): break
    return best, len(best)
final_labels = []
bad = 0
for k in range(0, len(sp_recs), 40):
    ch = [(r[0], r[3]) for r in sp_recs[k:k+40]]
    d, n = classify_retry(ch)
    if n < len(ch): bad += len(ch)-n
    for i in range(len(ch)):
        final_labels.append(d.get(i, None))
print(len(final_labels), "unparsed:", sum(1 for x in final_labels if x is None), "bad:", bad)
print(Counter(final_labels))
valid = [x for x in final_labels if x]
print(round(100*valid.count('g')/len(valid),1))
